## Audit outcome and scope

K0 completed normally, not through a budget or technical stop: `main_agent` committed `1f96d6a` on `feature/table-conversions` (events 101–103), with `end_turn` and completed status. The official evaluation reports **F2P 60/60, P2P 964/964, and binary success 1**. These are separate from the student’s local checks and do not establish correctness beyond the evaluated cases. No B0 trajectory or baseline metrics are supplied, so baseline behavior and any comparison with B0 are unassessable.

Sources: the supplied trajectory at `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_20261126_020200/runs/capability_v1_test_tomlkit-toml-table-converters_K0_r1/infer_logs/tomlkit-toml-table-converters/turn_1/trajs.json`; loaded guidance at the sibling `loaded_capabilities.md`; and official result at `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_20261126_020200/runs/capability_v1_test_tomlkit-toml-table-converters_K0_r1/eval_output/tomlkit-toml-table-converters/eval_result.json`. Program paths below are under `/app`.

## Exploration, changes, and validation

`main_agent` created the requested branch, searched for repository instructions and relevant classes, and established that the public converter import was absent (events 1–8). It inspected `tomlkit/container.py`, `items.py`, `api.py`, and `parser.py`; executable probes exposed the distinct representations of dotted keys, nested tables, inline tables, quoted paths, and `OutOfOrderTableProxy` (events 9–30). A temporary reproduction initially failed on the missing import (events 13, 18).

The committed patch adds `tomlkit/convert.py`, implementing the four conversions, parser-based path lookup, recursive rendering, comment handling, and error cases; adds `ConversionError` in `tomlkit/exceptions.py`; and re-exports the functions in `tomlkit/__init__.py` (events 32–40, 101–102; supplied final patch). The implementation uses internal container bodies and maps, including manual map-index adjustments for migrated comments. No permanent test file was added in the observed commit.

Local checks found and repaired several intermediate defects: malformed nested inline syntax (events 41–48); proxy and repeated dotted-key handling (49–72); loss of empty nested tables (73–78); and misplaced header comments (83–98). These were real intermediate regressions, not evidence that the final patch retained them. The final local import/reproduction and existing suite passed, with 964 tests in 42.04 seconds (99–100). The student’s final message claims those checks and the commit (103); tool returns directly corroborate them. Official F2P and P2P results come separately from the evaluation, not from that message.

The exploratory probes and fixes went beyond the basic reproduction but addressed concrete observed failures; their necessity for the official test set is unknown. The student ran the existing suite twice, costing approximately 43 and 42 seconds of test time (48, 100). Formatting tools were unavailable (94–96); `git diff --check` produced no reported errors, but that is not a formatter run. Some read/write and final-diff event contents are truncated (8, 14–17, 39, 90, 100), so their omitted details cannot independently establish what was inspected or changed; the supplied final patch provides the final code. No unseen failures should be inferred from those truncations.

Reported run costs were 51 requested tool calls, all returned, 33 model requests, 2,235,018 input and 9,702 output tokens, 1,117.929 seconds wall time, and 12,177 patch bytes. The SDK’s $11.41764 `total_cost_usd` is a proxy estimate, **not an actual CLI fee**. The metadata separately reports 445,440 cached input tokens in attempt metrics and zero cache-read tokens in the SDK usage; these measures should not be silently reconciled.

## Capability assessment

The four capabilities were present in the actual prompt, but matching actions do not prove adoption or causation: an ordinary base student could perform them. The student did not explicitly claim to follow any capability. Capability 3 has the closest executable match: parser-based key handling, structural probes, recursive conversion, and comment/round-trip checks. Fidelity was imperfect during development, as the observed malformed output, lost empty tables, and misplaced comment show; later local checks passed for those examples. Full source-fidelity coverage remains unproven.

Capability 4 also has direct matches: negative AoT checks, output and round-trip checks, existing tests, diff review, and branch/commit verification. No explicit requirement-to-check matrix or committed integration tests are visible; this is absence of observed method, not evidence of a hidden method. For capability 1, recursive conversion and explicit error propagation are superficial matches, but there is no observed invocation lifecycle, streaming/resumption, identifier correlation, or cycle test; those workflow-specific recommendations were not evidently applicable. Capability 2’s persisted inference-schema guidance has no observed relevant implementation or reload test and is not evidently applicable to this TOML conversion task. Truncated events limit conclusions about omitted material, not the directly visible actions.

| Capability/theme | Observed action | Agent/event IDs | Inference limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stateful control flow | Recursive conversion and explicit conversion errors | `main_agent` 39, 79–80 | Not the guidance’s orchestration, resumption, or cycle-check workflow; truncated initial write |
| Persisted schema | No relevant schema persistence or inference reload observed | `main_agent` 32–40, 99–103 | Apparently inapplicable; absence in visible record is not proof about omitted text |
| Syntax and fidelity | Parsed quoted paths; checked nesting, comments, and round trips; repaired failures | `main_agent` 19–30, 41–48, 73–78, 91–98 | Consistent behavior, not proof of library causation or universal fidelity |
| Observable contracts | Negative AoT probes, local suite, final diff and commit | `main_agent` 79–80, 99–103 | No visible matrix or committed test file; local suite is distinct from official F2P/P2P |
| Baseline B0 | No B0 record supplied | None | No baseline behavior or knowledge adoption can be assessed |
